name: CSV to Excel (XLSX)
summary: Convert CSV to a downloadable .xlsx workbook entirely in your browser.
description: Paste CSV, choose delimiter and sheet name, then download a real Excel .xlsx file. Built client-side with SheetJS — nothing is uploaded to a server.

faqs.question: Is the Excel file built on a server?
faqs.answer: No. The .xlsx workbook is generated in your browser and downloaded locally.

faqs.question: Can I name the sheet?
faqs.answer: Yes — up to 31 characters (Excel’s sheet-name limit).

faqs.question: Is my CSV uploaded?
faqs.answer: No. Conversion runs entirely in your browser.
